checkpoint.wireValues: Explicit unsigned 32-bit integer values; host JSON encoding independent of byte order/native layout
checkpoint.boundaryAuthority: Host phase/resume declares the boundary; C verifies HP/outcome/action/profile consistency. The core alone cannot distinguish every host continuation. Host-C cross-validation is required.
checkpoint.restoration: Validate every scalar and all words-present flags before mutation; copy scalar staging locally; reset to fresh instance defaults; assign logical fields without calling source commands/RNG or replaying inputs.
checkpoint.atomicity: Invalid stage/word/version/count/relationship leaves existing gameplay state and events unchanged. Status and transport staging may change. Successful import deliberately replaces the state and clears consumed observations.

rng.hook: Macro alias after original Random definition routes every later source/adapter call to a wrapper which calls original once and counts it.
rng.initialBoundary: After omitted intro effects and before first selection draw
rng.validation: O(64) modular affine LCG composition validates initialSeed + exact draw count against current state. It consumes no gameplay draw; runtime RNG remains source Random.
rng.wrapPolicy: Low word rolls into high word; safe-integer count limit rejects before another original draw. Parent host drops any failed transition.

futureBehaviorArgument: Preserve active stats/types/status/stages/moves/PP, baseline types, RNG state/count and outcome.
Preserve selected actions AND old chosen slots across before-residual replacement: source FALSE comparator looks up the newly active move at the retained slot.
Restore histories carried by public raw state getters; other command diagnostics/events are consumed observations, not checkpoint promises.
Reconstruct fixed count/positions/empty capabilities and local pointers; reset excluded or overwritten scratch.

Host serializes parties, active indices, turn/transition/event counters, phase/resume, outcome and profile/source envelope. C party projection can be stale and is overwritten before source outcome queries.
expansionObligation: Adding any move, item, ability, status, volatile effect, double battle or resumable source script requires a new read/write audit before enabling it.

If a previously omitted field can affect a future branch, include it logically and bump checkpoint/profile version with an explicit compatibility or migration policy. Do not reuse v1 for broader semantics.
Source function/service additions must retain fail-closed admission. No unknown dependency may be answered with generic zero/success.
Repeat all checkpoint mutation, golden replay, replacement/terminal restoration and interleaving checks with new state categories.
limitations: No raw linear-memory snapshot or native pointer serialization
No suspend/resume within original C scripts or pending controller acknowledgments
No cryptographic authentication or historical reachability proof for imported checkpoints
Schema validity is for trusted server state; host validates cross-layer consistency before loading a fresh private instance
